results.title: Home [Entomological Suite]
results.overview: A brief record of the insects and arachnids that visited my house during a very hot summer in Buenos Aires.

results.title: Wizard of Death: Tinman's Rise
results.overview: A family outing spirals into a fight for survival against the Tin Man, a heart-hungry machine risen from the ruins of Oz.

results.title: I Think My Dad's a Cyborg and I Think He Killed My Mum
results.original_title: I Think My Dad's a Cyborg and I Think He Killed My Mum
results.overview: A lonely year after his mother’s death, awkward hermit Peter is still no closer to his father, and he thinks he knows the reason why; a reason which he must confront at the family gathering before the secret spirals out of control...his dad MUST be a murderous cyborg.

results.title: The Way of Seeing Life
results.overview: Christian, an old painter, decides that if he wants to continue living with the memories of the ones he loves, and not lose a part of himself, he has to leave through unconventional means. A bittersweet story told in 4 chapters, each depicting a different perspective… on life

results.title: Last Harmony
results.overview: Jake pierces time itself in a desperate attempt to play a song with his late mother.

results.title: The Beast in the Cave
results.overview: A young security guard enters a forbidden cave after hearing a cry for help, only to discover that something monstrous lurks within its darkness.

results.title: L'estinzione della razza umana
results.overview: 2020. A misterious virus that transforms people into turkeys is infecting the global population. Authorities have imposed a rigid lockdown that prevents people from going out. The main characters are two couples of friends who argue about philosophical, political and social disagreements, ending up fighting for futile reasons, despite the imminent danger.

results.title: All the Way Down
results.overview: Alex, a burnt-out composer, seeks a creative spark when she travels to a mysterious inherited lake property. There, she encounters a family secret and an otherworldly sound that may provide divine inspiration or drive her to madness.

results.title: Verity
results.overview: A man wishes for Verity to be real, but sometimes wishes shouldn't come true.

results.title: No Money No Honey
results.overview: During her glorious years as a sex worker in '90s and early 2000s Miami, Máxima documented the wild escapades she shared with her glamorous trans Latinx friends. Revisiting VHS tapes decades later, she reflects on where everyone ended up, what they carried with them, and the ghosts that linger. As past and present collapse, the images of their unfolding trajectories open a broader exploration of the conditions that have shaped their fates.

results.title: Absorber
results.overview: A drifter's betrayal comes out on a motel phone call. Before it's over, a beautiful stranger is waiting outside his door. She has a place in the desert to show him, then disappears in the night. By morning, so does every road out.

results.title: The Couch
results.overview: An aging Albanian woman becomes obsessed after her beloved couch is secretly sold.

results.title: Will - Short Film
results.overview: After going through the dull motions of a non eventful day, a downhearted elderly man (William Harrold) finds joy in what matters most.

results.title: Girls' Door
results.overview: Sabriyya finds herself trapped in the whirlwind of caring for her domineering mother, Turkiya, turning her daily life into a chain of comedic situations. As unusual characters and new guests enter their home, relationships become entangled and the humorous moments escalate.

results.title: Hybrid | PWU: Midnight Xpress
results.overview: The neon lights of the Las Vegas Strip meet the grit of the independent scene for a midnight spectacle like no other. Hybrid Wrestling and Pro Wrestling Unplugged (PWU) join forces to kick off "The Collective" with Midnight Xpress.

results.title: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
results.overview: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

results.original_title: Das Erbe von 9/11 – Deutschland nach den Anschlägen

results.title: All About the Money
results.overview: A son of one of America’s wealthiest families creates a communist revolutionary base in rural Massachusetts as a means of disrupting the capitalist system he grew up in, but has now come to despise. It’s the starting point of an astonishing journey.

results.title: Bluebird
results.overview: Noah leaves London behind for the industrial banks of the Thames, where they’re invited into a state of in-between, as the city fades away and the river turns to sea.  Searching for direction on the quiet banks, they encounter a dancer, whose movement gives form to Noah’s unspoken thoughts. Stirred by the moment, they’re then met with a mysterious figure who reawakens their sense of purpose and hope. Noah begins to mirror the shifting landscape, learning to find comfort in flux.  A meditative, voiceover-driven film written by Zohrab Yoncali, based on the PhD research of artist Nic Farr.
